apollo-desktop.panel: Observed ⓘ : data source and known limitations Known limitations Fixed to the J2000 frame: no precession and no star proper motion, so it does not change with the clock. Stars are tinted from the B-V colour index and sized by magnitude; they are not photometrically exact. Accuracy Star directions are the catalogue's J2000 positions to about an arcsecond. The Milky Way picture is the ESO photograph
